articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved multi-step reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a larger effective context window. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex coding tasks, narrowing the gap toward robust agentic workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini Ultra 2 with Real-Time Tool Use and Long-Context Grounding
articles.summary: DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 introduces improved grounded generation with citation-level attribution and the ability to orchestrate dozens of external tools in a single turn. Early benchmarks show substantial gains in factual accuracy and reduced hallucination rates, positioning it as a strong contender for enterprise RAG applications.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory assembly stations, handling component sorting and light manipulation tasks alongside human workers. The robots leverage on-device vision transformers and reinforcement learning policies trained in simulation, marking one of the first scaled humanoid deployments in heavy manufacturing.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Multi-Floor Warehouse Inspections
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics announced that its electric Atlas humanoid can now autonomously navigate multi-story warehouses, climb stairs, open doors, and perform visual inspections using onboard LiDAR and a fine-tuned vision-language model. The system reduces manual inspection time by an estimated 70% and can flag anomalies in real time via a centralized dashboard.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 with Constitutional Safeguards for Autonomous Agent Tasks
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude 4, emphasizing safe agentic behavior through an updated constitutional AI framework that allows the model to self-audit action plans before execution. The model supports long-running autonomous tasks such as multi-file codebase refactoring and research synthesis while maintaining alignment guardrails, targeting enterprise developer and research workflows.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process, expected to power the next generation of AI training and inference chips from major fabless customers. The node delivers approximately 20% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, critical for sustaining the scaling of large model training clusters.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Trial
articles.summary: The FDA has approved Neuralink's second-generation BCI implant for an expanded clinical trial involving patients with spinal cord injuries. The new device features 4x the electrode density of the N1 chip and a wireless data throughput sufficient for real-time cursor and robotic arm control, advancing the path toward commercial neural interface products.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production for Logistics
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round to expand manufacturing capacity for its Figure 02 humanoid robot, which is being piloted at BMW and Amazon fulfillment centers. The funding will also accelerate development of foundation models for dexterous manipulation, aiming to generalize pick-and-place skills across thousands of SKU categories.
